title: Pump + Filter + Fountain
goal: Install and test the low-maintenance 300 GPH integrated circulation and filtration system for the permanent pond.
preferredChoice: Option B — One Integrated 300 GPH System
decisionSummary: Option B selected: one integrated 300 GPH pump/filter system for lower maintenance and simpler plumbing.
whyPreferred: One pump means fewer components to clean and maintain.
Integrated mechanical and biological filtration keeps the plumbing simpler.
The 300 GPH system provides ample circulation for the Manhattan pond without excessive splash or flow.

comparison.name: Option A — Keep Existing Smartpond + Separate Filtration
comparison.includedEquipment: Existing small Smartpond fountain plus separate adjustable main pump, mechanical/biological filter and tubing.
tradeoffs: Estimated system cost about $143–153 including the existing $30 kit

comparison.name: Option B — One Integrated 300 GPH System
comparison.includedEquipment: smartpond 300 GPH pump, mechanical filtration, biological filtration and fountain hardware in one system.
strengths: Mechanical + biological filtration in one system
tradeoffs: Original $30 Smartpond kit will be returned
Extra tubing may still be needed depending on final placement

futureMaintenance: Clean mechanical filter pads as needed.
Check pump intake and water level during hot weather.
Add a UV clarifier later only if persistent green-water algae develops; UV does not solve string algae, wall algae or debris.
